name: Ryoujoku Sou
source:
Main character is an apartment complex manager. Inhabitants are on throats with each other, so protagonist has to  peek into their private lives to get to know about their problems. It's up to him whether he actually wants to solve those troubles or use them to force intimacy relations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一座公寓楼的管理员。住户之间关系紧张，因此他必须窥探私人生活来了解问题所在。是否真正解决这些麻烦，还是利用它们迫使住户发生亲密关系，全由他决定。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
